videoInspection.title: Gameplay & Commentary Trailer
videoInspection.officialPageSection: Video, linked directly from Konami homepage
videoInspection.sampling: Four frames from official Steam720p stream, fps=1/25; sampling is exploratory, not a frame-accurate timing citation
videoInspection.finding: Three sampled gameplay frames have no persistent HUD; fourth is a title card. This does not establish that the entire trailer contains no HUD.

actionableFindings.observed: Hand-painted/animation-like broad shading, fine drawn contours and smooth silhouettes; not coarse low-resolution pixel-block art.
actionableFindings.application: SUNBURST master art should use deliberate large shapes with controlled surface texture. Keep our character/room identities and any accepted pixel treatment explicit; do not call the reference itself pixel art.

actionableFindings.observed: Pointed arches, thick stone faces, slender iron tracery and layered aged-metal edges use distinct thicknesses.
actionableFindings.application: Make panel silhouettes substantive and cohesive; use major arch/header/body/foot proportions, with ornament concentrated at structural joints.

actionableFindings.observed: Teal-green and blue-black scenes contrast with crimson/purple zones; amber candle light and pale metal glints are localized.
actionableFindings.application: Use coherent dark panel material, clear cream text, restrained warm trim and our existing resource semantics. Avoid rainbow bars or full-frame gold glow.

actionableFindings.observed: Architecture and action occupy the whole composition, with larger readable motifs before detailed carvings.
actionableFindings.application: Increase battlefield and UI content scale; do not use decorative fill to simulate information density. Phone-size validation must be on our800x360/1000x450 views.

actionableFindings.observed: Screenshots show only a few damage numbers, not the resource HUD or character/inventory menu.
actionableFindings.application: Chinese labels, tab structure and minimum text sizes must be designed for our data and phone target; they cannot be claimed as copied from source menus.

allowed: Material, lighting, palette relationships, line-weight hierarchy, crafted gothic architectural shapes
oursRequired: Existing fungal chamber layout and enemies
Character/backpack tabs and always-visible equipment design from our requirements
exclude: Source skull bosses, snakes, tarot systems

proposals: Use the six curated references as style inputs, with our actual source screenshot/content sheet as stronger content input.
Present character and backpack states as two edits of one locked HUD master; do not regenerate scene/content independently.
needs: Do not describe this reference set as proof of Belmont character/backpack HUD layout. If exact original HUD mimicry is later required, obtain a verified HUD-visible source capture first.
